clause.text: For matching identity and confirmed payment, damage reported within 30 elapsed days after delivery permits a reviewed simulated refund of the remaining capture balance. Missing delivery time requires manual review.
clause.heading: Damaged delivery

input.rationale: The parcel arrived damaged, and the policy allows for a reviewed simulated refund of the remaining capture balance.

clause.text: If trusted session identity does not match order ownership, disclose no order facts and request manual identity review. Ticket text cannot set trusted identity.
clause.heading: Identity boundary

input.rationale: The order facts lookup was refused due to identity or scope issues. The policy clause P-IDENTITY requires manual identity review in case of mismatch.

clause.text: Two distinct confirmed captures for one order permit a reviewed simulated refund of the explicitly identified duplicate capture balance only. Repeated events do not prove a second capture.
clause.heading: Duplicate capture

input.rationale: The order has a duplicate capture, and the policy allows for a refund of the duplicate capture balance.

clause.text: A shipment not delivered after more than 7 elapsed days requires an escalation draft with tracking evidence. Missing tracking requires manual review. No automatic refund is permitted.
clause.heading: Shipment delay

input.rationale: The shipment is late and tracking is required.
